title: Amazon product launch checklist for brands entering the marketplace
description: Prepare your Amazon launch with four readiness gates covering product, economics, customer experience, and operations before increasing investment.
audience: Established US brands and manufacturers entering Amazon
intent: Plan a controlled launch and identify blockers before spending
visual: Interactive launch-readiness checklist: four gates, completion count, explicit unresolved blockers; no invented readiness score or promise of approval.
coverage: Agency founder covers Amazon launch sequencing and a 90-day checklist. Our angle is accountable launch gates for established brands; no competitor results reused.

title: Walmart listing optimization: what to fix before buying more traffic
description: Diagnose Walmart listing problems before increasing ad spend. Prioritize accurate content, a clear offer, and changes you can measure.
audience: US Walmart sellers with underperforming listings
intent: Prioritize listing corrections rather than increase traffic blindly
visual: Symptom selector revealing a tailored first check and evidence to collect; presented as a diagnostic aid, not an automated account audit.
coverage: Agency page targets Walmart Listing Quality optimization. Our article focuses on choosing the next correction and evaluating it without claiming score changes cause sales.

title: How to price eBay products using sold listings and your margin floor
description: Use comparable sold listings, shipping costs, and your contribution floor to make an eBay pricing decision you can defend.
audience: US eBay sellers and brands pricing comparable inventory
intent: Choose a defensible price using comparable transactions and costs
visual: Original comparison chart toggles item-only versus item-plus-shipping amounts, with calculated median and clearly hypothetical sample.
coverage: Commerce publisher covers eBay pricing and margins; not verified as an agency. Used as topic-coverage evidence only. Our example explains normalizing shipping before evaluating the margin floor.

title: Amazon negative keywords: what to exclude and what to investigate first
description: Separate irrelevant traffic from inconclusive performance before adding Amazon negative keywords. Use relevance, economics, and a clear decision log.
audience: Existing Amazon advertisers reviewing Sponsored Products traffic
intent: Decide which traffic to exclude without suppressing useful demand
visual: Three-scenario decision explorer with explicit reasons and next checks; no campaign changes and no universal click-based exclusion rule.
coverage: Specialist publisher covers search-term-based negative keyword selection. Our angle separates incompatibility from uncertain performance; not a second ACoS definition article.
